boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Named destinations on Hyde Park corridors bordering the University of Chicago campus.

cards.title: Lakefront park time
cards.subtitle: South Lake Shore Drive, off the 55th Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk east from campus for a daylight stop on the lakefront; use the park’s posted hours when planning a longer shoreline visit.
cards.short_summary: A named lakefront point within Burnham Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Chicago Park District lists Promontory Point at 5491 S. Jean-Baptiste Pointe DuSable Lake Shore Drive and posts park hours of 6 a.m.–11 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Public park; official page lists daily hours of 6 a.m.–11 p.m.

cards.entity_name: Museum of Science and Industry, Chicago
cards.title: Science exhibition visit
cards.subtitle: East 57th Street / DuSable Lake Shore Drive corridor
cards.notes: Choose an exhibition before leaving campus and check current ticket options online; build in time for the museum’s large indoor galleries.
cards.short_summary: A Hyde Park science museum with exhibition galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: The Museum of Science and Industry’s official visit page provides visitor and ticket information for its Hyde Park museum.
cards.source_title: Visit | Museum of Science and Industry, Chicago
cards.access_notes: Check the official visit page for current admission, timed-entry, and hours information.

cards.title: Independent bookstore browsing
cards.subtitle: East 57th Street corridor
cards.notes: Browse the shelves or look for a scheduled author event; consult the shop’s official calendar and hours before making the walk.
cards.short_summary: An independent bookstore on the 57th Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: 57th Street Books’ official website identifies it as a Hyde Park bookstore and publishes its events and store information.
cards.access_notes: Retail business; verify current hours and event details on its official site.

cards.title: Reader-owned bookshop
cards.subtitle: Woodlawn Avenue beside the 57th Street corridor
cards.notes: Stop in to browse the bookstore, then check the official events listing for a reading or discussion that fits your schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Seminary Co-op Bookstores’ official website identifies the Seminary Co-op as a reader-owned bookstore and provides its Hyde Park location information.
cards.access_notes: Retail business; consult the official site for current store hours and events.

cards.title: Campus-edge art galleries
cards.subtitle: Greenwood Avenue beside the 55th/56th Street corridor
cards.notes: Select a current exhibition, then take a focused gallery break just east of campus; check the visit page for any program changes.
cards.short_summary: The University of Chicago’s art museum and gallery space.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smart Museum of Art’s official visit page states that admission is free and gives its location at 5550 S. Greenwood Avenue.
cards.source_title: Visit the Smart Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Free admission; check the official visit page for current gallery hours.

cards.title: Contemporary art programs
cards.subtitle: Cornell Avenue beside the 51st Street corridor
cards.notes: Visit the galleries, then review the program calendar for a talk, workshop, or open-studio event that is open to the public.
cards.short_summary: A Hyde Park arts center with galleries and public programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Hyde Park Art Center’s official visit page lists 5020 S. Cornell Avenue and states that exhibitions are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free exhibitions during public gallery hours; verify program registration online.

cards.title: Garden and lagoon paths
cards.subtitle: Stony Island Avenue at the east end of the 57th Street corridor
cards.notes: Use daylight hours to explore the park paths and Garden of the Phoenix; check weather and park conditions before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A major South Side park containing the Garden of the Phoenix.
cards.evidence_claim: Chicago Park District identifies Jackson Park as the site of the Garden of the Phoenix, a Japanese garden within the park.
cards.access_notes: Public park; outdoor access may be affected by weather or park operations.

cards.title: 53rd Street gathering point
cards.subtitle: Harper Avenue and 53rd Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the plaza as a meeting point, then check the University’s Hyde Park information for currently listed businesses and seasonal activity.
cards.short_summary: A mixed-use development on the 53rd Street commercial corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Chicago architecture site lists Harper Court at 5235 S. Harper Court and describes it as part of the 53rd Street economic corridor.
cards.source_title: Harper Court | Explore the Architecture at the University of Chicago
cards.access_notes: Outdoor commercial setting; individual tenants and events have separate hours or purchase requirements.

cards.title: Community retail and events
cards.subtitle: East 53rd Street corridor
cards.notes: Check the shop’s own schedule before going for a retail visit or public event; its East 53rd Street location is beside Harper Court.
cards.short_summary: A named retail and community-gathering destination on 53rd Street.
cards.evidence_claim: A University of Chicago 53rd Street announcement identifies The Silver Room as a community gathering place at 1506 E. 53rd Street.
cards.source_title: 2026 Lineup Announced for Harper Court Summer Music Series
cards.access_notes: Retail and event venue; confirm current hours and event access directly before visiting.

cards.title: See a current film
cards.subtitle: Harper Avenue beside the 53rd Street corridor
cards.notes: Check the current showtimes and ticket availability online, then plan your visit around the film’s listed start time and rating.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood movie theater at Harper Court.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Chicago’s Hyde Park information lists Harper Theater among businesses in the 53rd Street and Harper Court area.
cards.source_title: Pre-College Welcome Packet | University of Chicago
cards.access_notes: Ticketed cinema; confirm showtimes, ratings, and ticket availability before attending.
